audit.whatIsWrong: The content chart read Skill/Gragas/Gragas/Skill/Skill/Gragas/Gragas while its own why-text says Vlad wins level 1, the trade is even at 3, he pokes you out at 4-5, you get a real kill at 6, first item is even, and he 'out-scales you decisively' late. whys[0] was not even level-1 text — it was a duplicate of the late-game paragraph. The full layer had different sides again.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Vladimir / Gragas / Skill / Vladimir / Gragas / Skill / Vladimir, which is exactly what the prose describes, and the early paragraph itself says 'concede that Levels 1 and 3 lean his way'. Win rate 48.38% over 525 games supports a lane you do not simply win.
audit.corrected: Both charts flipped as one atomic group to Vladimir / Gragas / Skill / Vladimir / Gragas / Skill / Vladimir, ratings adjusted, and whys[0] rewritten as actual level-1 content.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer phase why-strings were generic placeholders that never named a spike, and phases[6].why claimed 'your side-lane pattern is at full power' in the stage the content layer correctly gives to Vladimir.
audit.why: The real spikes are: his level 1 free-cast Transfusion, your level 2 Q+W sustain window, his Tides of Blood poke at 4-5, your level 6 cask-off-tower kill, and his two-item Crimson Pact scaling.
audit.corrected: All seven phase why-strings rewritten around those spikes with real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never stated the decisive interaction. Sanguine Pool is 2 seconds of untargetability on a 28-second cooldown at rank 1 — it does not merely 'dodge burst', it erases a spent Body Slam stun or Explosive Cask entirely. Nor did anything record that every Vladimir ability costs 0 mana (he pays health), which is why a cooldown-trading war favours him, or that Crimson Pact converts bonus health into AP and AP into health.
audit.why: Riot text and costs: Q cost 0, W cost 0 cd 28/25/22/19/16 'untargetable for 2 seconds', E cost 0 cd 13/11/9/7/5, R cd 120 cost 0 'affected enemies take increased damage... heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit'; passive 'every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power'.
audit.corrected: Written into tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull, dontsFull, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed 'Your committal tool' and 'Your ultimate' instead of the two numbers that decide every commit.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool 28s at rank 1 and Tides of Blood 13s at rank 1 are the punishable windows.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with both, plus the free-cast note.

audit.why: report[8] already prescribes Mercury's Treads and an early Executioner's Calling, which is right against a champion whose Q, W and R all heal him.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now explains why anti-heal is mandatory rather than repeating the trading line.

edits.before: Full-AP Vlad pools your Body Slam and Cask, drain-tanks the combo with Transfusion, and bursts your HP pool — he hard out-scales you.
edits.after: Vlad edges level 1 — Transfusion costs him no mana and heals off you or the wave, while your Q costs 80 and you have no sustain yet.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Vladimir contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Transfusion is free to cast and heals off you or the wave, so he wins the level 1 attrition. Farm and wait for your 2.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Vladimir's Sanguine Pool is down.
edits.after: Q+W and Happy Hour out-sustain a single Tides of Blood charge — Sanguine Pool is not ranked yet, so force it now.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Vladimir must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Tides of Blood matches your 600 Body Slam range and costs him nothing — neither side commits cleanly.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Sanguine Pool's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He charges Tides of Blood at 600 and refunds the chip with a free Transfusion while your Q sits on 8s — max W and farm to 6.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vladimir's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Explosive Cask knocks him off his tower into your combo — your one clean kill before Sanguine Pool's 28s resets. Hemoplague is a 120s answer.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Sanguine Pool's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker spikes your all-in, but Transfusion's scaling heal keeps the race square.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Vladimir carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool eats your stun or your cask outright and Crimson Pact turns his health into AP. Carry threat 8.5/10 — never side-lane him.

edits.before: Q-poke Vladimir on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Barrel Roll at 850 from fog, W as he steps up, Body Slam only once Sanguine Pool is spent — 28s at rank 1.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Committing while Sanguine Pool is up — 2 seconds untargetable erases your stun and your cask.

edits.before: Dodges your burst. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 2s untargetable, 28s at rank 1 — bait it with Q, then commit.

edits.before: Q-poke Vladimir on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Every Vlad ability costs 0 mana and his Q heals him — Grievous Wounds is not optional, buy it first back.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Pool is 2s of untargetable — a stun or cask spent into it buys him 28 free seconds.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: All his damage is magic — health without MR just makes you a bigger target.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Hemoplague amplifies every source of damage on you, then heals him off each champion hit.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Dodges your burst. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 2 seconds untargetable — it erases your stun or your cask outright, so bait it first. - Tides of Blood: 13s at rank 1, and free to cast. - Explosive Cask: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Vladimir's Sanguine Pool: Dodges your burst. Bait it. When it is down — E-Q burst him.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool: 2s untargetable on a 28s cooldown at rank 1. Bait it, then Body Slam into cask.
